name: How long does a typical tile floor replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical tile floor replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a tile floor replacement project depends on several factors, including the size of the area, the type of tile being installed, and the condition of the existing subfloor. Generally, a small to medium-sized room (e.g., a bathroom) might take 2-4 days, while a larger area (e.g., a kitchen or multiple rooms) could require 5-10 days or more. This timeframe includes demolition, subfloor preparation, tile setting, grouting, and curing. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project length varies by size and complexity, but a small room typically takes 2-4 days, and larger areas 5-10 days. This includes demolition, preparation, setting, and grouting.
